# Session timeouts

INFO-unverified. Read these three in System Settings: the screensaver idle delay, display sleep, and whether a password is required on wake.

**Read in System Settings:**
- Screen saver: start after
- Display sleep: turn display off when inactive
- Lock Screen: require password after screen saver begins or display is turned off

| Setting | Where |
|---|---|
| Screensaver delay | System Settings > Lock Screen |
| Display off timeout | System Settings > Lock Screen |
| Require password on wake | System Settings > Lock Screen |
